# Introduction

To analyze heart single-cell atlas annotation with ISC

https://www.heartcellatlas.org/v1.html


# 0. Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, 
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)
```

```{r libraries}
# Load packages
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(BiocParallel)
library(Seurat)
library(scTypeEval)
library(tibble)
source("helpers/consistency_exploration.R")
# Custom theme
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 12))
```

Define which ISC paramters
```{r set_ISC}
#black list from scTypeEval package
data(black_list)
bl <- list(black_list$TCR, black_list$Immunoglobulins, black_list$Ygenes) %>% unlist()
# define used ISC
mety <- c("local" = "silhouette | recip_classif:Match",
          "global" = "2label_silhouette | Pseudobulk:Cosine")

# mety <- c("local" = "silhouette | recip_classif:Match",
#           "global" = "NeighborhoodPurity | Pseudobulk:Cosine")
# Define dissimilarities to use
dm <- c("Pseudobulk:Cosine",
        "recip_classif:Match")
# min samples to consider a cell type
min_samples <- 3
min_cells <- 10
```


# 1. Load dataset

```{r}
lpath <- "~/Documents/Projects/ISC_benchmark_reproducibility/data/hca_global_raw.h5ad"

object <- load_single_cell_object(lpath)
object$metadata %>%
  distinct(donor, cell_source, source, version, sample, region)
# add cell source as sample
object$metadata$sample_id <- paste(object$metadata$cell_source,
                                   object$metadata$donor,
                                   sep = "-")

ident <- "cell_type" # annotation column to use
sample = "sample" # column identifying sample of origin

n_distinct(object$metadata[[sample]])
unique(object$metadata[[ident]])
table(is.na(object$metadata[[ident]]))
```




# 2. Run scTypeEval

## 2.1 Processing

```{r}
md <- object$metadata %>%
  filter(grepl("Nuclei", cell_source))
counts <- object$counts[,rownames(md)]
#create sceval object
sc <- create_scTypeEval(matrix = counts,
                        metadata = md,
                        black_list = bl)

sc <- run_processing_data(sc,
                          ident = ident,
                          sample = sample,
                          # enforce more cell type by lower threshold of samples
                          min_samples = min_samples,
                          min_cells = min_cells,
                          verbose = F)

sc <- run_hvg(sc, 
              aggregation = "single-cell",
              ngenes = 2000,
              var_method = "scran",
              ncores = 5, 
              verbose = F)

# no need to run pca on single-cell data
single_mat <- sc@data$`single-cell`
sc@data$`single-cell` <- NULL

sc <- run_pca(sc,
              scale. = F,
              verbose = F)

for(mdiss in dm){
  cat("#### Running ", mdiss, " ####\n")
  sc <- run_dissimilarity(sc,
                          method = mdiss,
                          ncores = 7,
                          verbose = F)
}
# return single-cell data for SCCAF and MetaNeighbor
sc@data$`single-cell` <- single_mat
rm(single_mat); gc()
```


### check sparsity across modalities
Nuclei vs whole-cell, to check if HVG actually takes into account this

```{r}
feats <- sc@gene_lists$HVG
ps <- get_pseudobulk(sc,
                     ident = ident,
                     sample = sample,
                     genes = feats)

mmd <- object$metadata %>%
  mutate(!!sample := scTypeEval:::purge_label(.data[[sample]]),
         !!ident := scTypeEval:::purge_label(.data[[ident]]),
         id = paste(.data[[sample]], .data[[ident]], sep = "_")
         ) %>% 
  distinct(id, cell_source)

ps$metadata <- ps$metadata %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("id") %>% 
  left_join(., mmd, by = "id") %>% 
  tibble::column_to_rownames("id")

phall <- do_heatmap(ps,
                    do_scale = F,
                    cluster_cols = T,
                    cluster_rows = T)
```

### zero counts?

```{r}
zero_genes <- as.data.frame(ps$matrix) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = "id",
    values_to = "counts"
  ) %>%
  filter(counts == 0) %>%
  left_join(
    ps$metadata %>% rownames_to_column("id") %>%
      select(id, cell_source),
    by = "id"
  )

zero_summary <- as.data.frame(ps$matrix) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = "id",
    values_to = "counts"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    ps$metadata %>% rownames_to_column("id") %>%
      select(id, cell_source),
    by = "id"
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene, cell_source) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    n_zero = sum(counts == 0),
    prop_zero = mean(counts == 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(zero_summary, aes(x = cell_source, y = gene, fill = prop_zero)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 1), name = "Proportion\nzero") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

# 3. Consistency

```{r}
cons0 <- get_consistency(sc,
                         consistency_metric = c("silhouette",
                                                "2label_silhouette",
                                                "NeighborhoodPurity")
)

cons <- 
  cons0 %>% 
  mutate(method.type = paste(consistency_metric,
                             dissimilarity_method,
                             sep = " | ")) %>% 
  filter(method.type %in% mety) %>% 
  mutate(method.type = factor(method.type,
                              levels = mety,
                              labels = names(mety))) %>% 
  select(method.type, measure, celltype) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "method.type",
              values_from = "measure") %>% 
  mutate(measure = global * local
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(measure))

consis <- cons %>%
  arrange(measure)
```

## 3.1. plotting
### barplot
```{r}
q_local <- 0.45
q_global <- 0.74
consistency_barplot(consis, x_threshold = q_local)
consistency_barplot(consis, xval = "global",
                    x_threshold = q_global, xlabel = "global")
```
### scatter

Joint distribution of per-cell-type ISCL (silhouette on reciprocal-classification match) and ISCG (2-label silhouette on pseudobulk cosine similarity) across atlas labels (“cell_type”). Each point represents one annotated cell type. 

```{r}
consistency_scatter(consis)
```

#### Number of cells/sample


```{r}
th <- 10

# Calculate proportion of samples with zero counts per cell type
pl_comp <- lapply(c("ventricular", "atrial"),
                  function(r){
                    
                    df <- object$metadata %>% 
                      mutate(region_id = ifelse(region %in% c("AX", "LV", "RV", "SP"),
                                                "ventricular",
                                                "atrial")) %>% 
                      filter(region_id == r,
                             grepl("Nuclei", cell_source)) %>% 
                      mutate(cell_states = as.character(cell_states),
                             sample = as.character(sample)) %>% 
                      {table(.[["cell_states"]], .[["sample"]])} %>% 
                      as.data.frame() %>% 
                      dplyr::rename(
                        cell_state = Var1,
                        sample = Var2
                      ) %>% 
                      filter(grepl("[a|v]CM", cell_state))
                    
                    zero_prop <- df %>%
                      group_by(cell_state) %>%
                      summarise(
                        prop_zero = mean(Freq < th),
                        .groups = "drop"
                      ) %>% 
                      mutate(label = scales::percent(prop_zero, accuracy = 1))
                    
                    comp_pl <- df %>% 
                      ggplot(aes(cell_state, Freq)) +
                      geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE,
                                   outlier.colour = NA) +
                      geom_jitter(
                        aes(color = sample),
                        show.legend = FALSE,
                        width = 0.2
                      ) + 
                      geom_label(
                        data = zero_prop,
                        aes(x = cell_state, y = Inf, label = label),
                        fill = "orange",
                        alpha = 0.3,
                        inherit.aes = FALSE,
                        vjust = 1.5,
                        size = 5
                      ) + 
                      geom_hline(yintercept = th,
                                 linetype = "dashed",
                                 color = "brown") +
                      scale_y_log10() +
                      labs(y = "Number of cells per sample") +
                      ggpubr::theme_classic2() +
                      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14,
                                                       angle = 45,
                                                       hjust = 1, 
                                                       vjust = 1))
                    return(comp_pl)
                    
                  })  

pl_comp[[1]] / pl_comp[[2]]

```

### try model batch effect
not possible due to incomplete rank

```{r}
norm_mat <- sc@data$`single-cell`@matrix
norm_mat <- norm_mat[!rownames(norm_mat) %in% bl,]
mds <- sc@metadata[colnames(norm_mat),]
block <- mds$sample
ngenes = 2000
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + cell_source, mds)

var <- scran::modelGeneVar(x = norm_mat,
                           block = block,
                           equiweight = T)

hvg_design <- scran::getTopHVGs(var,
                         n=ngenes)

identical(hvg_design, sc@gene_lists$HVG)
```

### try removing batch effect

```{r}
norm_mat <- sc@data$pseudobulk@matrix
norm_mat <- norm_mat[!rownames(norm_mat) %in% bl,]
mds <- process_metadata_pseudobulk(sc@metadata,
                                   ident = "cell_states",
                                   sample = "sample",
                                   covariates = c("cell_source","sample", "cell_states"))
mds <- mds[colnames(norm_mat),]
batch <- mds$cell_source

br_mat <- remove_batch_effect(mat = norm_mat,
                              batch = batch)
```

```{r}
b <- "HCAHeart7844004"

norm_mat <- sc@data$pseudobulk@matrix
norm_mat <- norm_mat[!rownames(norm_mat) %in% bl,]
norm_mat <- norm_mat[sc@gene_lists$HVG,]
mat.split <- scTypeEval:::split_matrix(mat = norm_mat,
                                       ident = sc@data$pseudobulk@ident$fine_smc,
                                       sample = sc@data$pseudobulk@sample)
classifier <- scTypeEval:::singler_helper

pred1 <- classifier(mat.split[[a]]@matrix,
                    mat.split[[b]]@matrix,
                    ref.ident = mat.split[[b]]@ident)
pred2 <- classifier(mat.split[[b]]@matrix,
                    mat.split[[a]]@matrix,
                    ref.ident = mat.split[[a]]@ident)
```

#### Number of cells/sample



```{r}
th <- 10

df <- object$metadata %>% 
  filter(grepl("Nuclei", cell_source)) %>% 
  mutate(cell_states = as.character(cell_states),
         sample = as.character(sample)) %>% 
  {table(.[["cell_states"]], .[["sample"]])} %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::rename(
    cell_state = Var1,
    sample = Var2
  ) %>% 
  filter(grepl("SMC|PC", cell_state))

df <- left_join(df, object$metadata %>% 
                  distinct(sample, region),
                by = "sample") %>% 
  mutate(region = factor(region,
                         levels = c("RA", "LA",
                                    "LV", "AX",
                                    "SP", "RV")))

zero_prop <- df %>%
  group_by(region, cell_state) %>%
  summarise(
    prop_zero = mean(Freq < th),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(label = scales::percent(prop_zero, accuracy = 1))

dodge_width <- 0.8

comp_pl <- df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = cell_state, y = Freq, fill = region)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width),
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.2,
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = region),
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.1,
      dodge.width = dodge_width
    ),
    show.legend = FALSE,
    shape = 21,
    size = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = th,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "brown"
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(y = "Number of cells per sample") +
  ggpubr::theme_classic2() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1
    )
  )

comp_pl
```

### ISC
```{r}
md <- object$metadata %>% 
  mutate(fine_lym = ifelse(grepl("Lymph", .data[[ident]]),
                           as.character(.data[["cell_states"]]),
                           as.character(.data[[ident]])
                           )
         ) %>% 
  filter(grepl("Nuclei", cell_source))
counts <- object$counts[,rownames(md)]
unique(md$fine_lym)
```

```{r}
sc <- create_scTypeEval(matrix = counts,
                        metadata = md,
                        black_list = bl)

sc <- run_processing_data(sc,
                          ident = "fine_lym",
                          sample = sample,
                          # enforce more cell type by lower threshold of samples
                          min_samples = min_samples,
                          min_cells = min_cells,
                          verbose = F)

sc <- run_hvg(sc,
              ngenes = 2000,
              aggregation = "single-cell",
              var_method = "scran",
              ncores = 4, 
              verbose = F)

sc@data$`single-cell` <- NULL
sc <- run_pca(sc, 
              scale. = F,
              verbose = F)

for(mdiss in dm){
  cat("#### Running ", mdiss, " ####\n")
  sc <- run_dissimilarity(sc,
                          method = mdiss,
                          ncores = 8,
                          verbose = F)
}
```

```{r}
plot_pca(sc)
```


```{r}
plot_heatmap(sc, 
             dissimilarity_slot = "recip_classif:Match",
             sort_consistency = "silhouette",
             sort_similarity = "Pseudobulk:Cosine")
```

```{r}
cons0 <- get_consistency(sc,
                         consistency_metric = c("silhouette",
                                                "2label_silhouette")
)

cons <- 
  cons0 %>% 
  mutate(method.type = paste(consistency_metric,
                             dissimilarity_method,
                             sep = " | ")) %>% 
  filter(method.type %in% mety) %>% 
  mutate(method.type = factor(method.type,
                              levels = mety,
                              labels = names(mety))) %>% 
  select(method.type, measure, celltype) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "method.type",
              values_from = "measure") %>% 
  mutate(measure = global * local
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(measure))

consis <- cons %>%
  arrange(measure)
```

```{r}
consistency_scatter(consis) +
  geom_point(data = consis %>% 
               filter(grepl("CD4|NK|CD8|DC|B[.]|Mast", celltype)),
             color = "red")
```
